Harini Sasidharan Business Analyst

E-Mail : Harinisasidharan55@gmail.com Mob No: +91- 9940065393

PROFE SSION AL S U M M A R Y:

Business execution consultant with 13+ years of experience in investment banking and capital markets, Extensive expertise across the end-to-end trade lifecycle (front office, middle office, and back office), with strong knowledge of data governance, Proven track record in stakeholder management, regulatory compliance, risk reporting, and end-to-end project delivery within global banking environments. Strong experience collaborating with technology teams to translate business requirements into functional solutions and drive successful implementation.

P R O F E S S I O N A L E XPE RIEN CE: WNS- Worked as a Business Execution Consultant from Dec 2022 to Dec 2024.2Yrs Roles & Responsibilities:

Gathered and documented business requirements for reconciliation and exception – management

processes across investment banking operations.

Collaborated with operations, technology, and front – office stakeholders to define functional

specifications and improve reconciliation workflow.

Analyzed trade, cash, and position breaks, identifying root causes and driving timely resolution. • Prepared BRDs, FRDs, and User stories, and process flow diagrams to support system enhancements and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Coordinated UAT activities, ensuring successful delivery of reconciliation solutions and operational risk. • Supported enterprise data governance initiatives by defining data quality rules, business glossaries and data ownership responsibilities.

Collaborating with business and IT teams to establish data standards, lineage and management practices.

Liaise with business and various technical teams to ensure a mutual understanding of processes and

applications in daily and weekly sprint meetings and solutions discussions.

Collaborated with stakeholders, customers, ensuring transparent communication to meet project

deadlines. Designed, developed dashboards and visual reports to support data-driven decision-making.

Good knowledge of Trade life cycle - Front office, middle office & back office, etc.

Previous Organization: HCL Working as a Business Analyst – Trade confirmation and settlements, Rate fixing from June 2020 to Dec 2021.1.7 Yrs. Roles & Responsibilities:



Identify compile, analyze and document interface mapping requirements and business requirements that accurately and thoroughly reflect business needs.

Analyzed trade lifecycle and settlements workflows to identify process gaps, reduce failed trades, and

improve straight -through processing.

Collaborated with operations, technology and front – office teams to implement system enhancements

and ensure compliance with market and regulatory requirement.

● Perform data analysis and reconciliation to validate settlement accuracy and support User acceptance

testing.

Facilitated stakeholder meetings and coordinated issue resolution to ensure the timely delivery of

settlement- related initiatives.

Previous Organization: BNY Working as Process Associate (SA) from July2018 to Sep2020.2.2Yrs Roles & Responsibilities:

Communicate with Global stakeholders and gather requirements and produce business specifications ● Demonstrated good portfolio management skills and ability to develop delivery plans and manage multiple projects and regulatory and compliance imperatives.

Practical understanding of software development lifecycles and methods, including requirements

definition and testing in both waterfall and Agile environments.

Previous Org: TCS Working as a Process Associate from Jan2015 to Jun 2018 - 3.5yrs. ● Proficient in presenting to senior stakeholder in both business and technology ● Good exposure in Credit Risk Frameworks such as Basel II, III, IFRS 9 and Stress Testing ● Good communicator, engaging and able to work with offshore teams across various time zones ● Processes migrated through Knowledge Transfer (KT) and trained new joiners in the team.

Key Achievement:

• Certificate of recognition for the Star of the month award for being a top performer in July 2016.

I managed a key project involving Automation implementation for the global region.

Previous Org: HDFC Designation: Executive from Aug 2011 to Dec 2014 – 3.4yrs

Work with the custodians and brokers to capture bond rates and update them. ● Portfolio valuation is done by pricing and booking trades for investments as per client trade files. ● Monitoring and reporting on standards and performance targets and training new joiners in the team.

Educational Qualifications:

BCOM in Valliamal college for women, (2008-2011) (madras university) • PG Data science IMS pro school.

Declaration:

I hereby declare that the information furnished above is true to the best of my knowledge. Place: Date:

(Harini)
